The paper was published at ICLR 2022 and authored by Ofir Press, Noah A. Smith, and Mike Lewis. The paper is available on arXiv as arXiv paper 2108.12409.

### Key Contribution

The paper addresses how models can achieve extrapolation at inference time for sequences longer than training sequences, and introduces Attention with Linear Biases (ALiBi) as a solution.

ALiBi does not add positional embeddings to word embeddings; instead, it biases query-key attention scores with a penalty that is proportional to their distance.

## Summary of MultiChallenge (arXiv 2501.17399)

MultiChallenge is a pioneering benchmark evaluating large language models (LLMs) on conducting multi-turn conversations with human users, a crucial yet underexamined capability for their applications.

### Key Challenges

The benchmark identifies four categories of challenges: instruction retention, inference memory of user information, reliable versioned editing, and self-coherence. All 4 challenges require accurate instruction-following, context allocation, and in-context reasoning at the same time.

### Performance Results

Despite achieving near-perfect scores on existing multi-turn evaluation benchmarks, all frontier models have less than 50% accuracy on MultiChallenge, with the top-performing Claude 3.5 Sonnet (June 2024) achieving just a 41.4% average accuracy.

### Evaluation Methodology

The researchers developed LLM as judge with instance-level rubrics to facilitate an automatic evaluation method with fair agreement with experienced human raters.

### Dataset Construction

The benchmark was constructed using a hybrid approach in which synthetic data was generated first and then human experts reviewed and edited it. A multi-agent synthetic data generation system created synthetic multi-turn conversations following the definition of the 4 challenges, and human annotators then reviewed and edited the synthetic data to produce final test examples.

## Overview

The logit lens was introduced by nostalgebraist (2020), who found that when the hidden states at each layer of GPT-2 are decoded with the unembedding matrix, the resulting distributions converge roughly monotonically to the final answer.

## Core Concept

The Logit Lens methodology operates on the principle that intermediate layer activations contain progressively refined predictions about subsequent tokens. By projecting intermediate layer activations through the model's final language modeling head, researchers can observe how token prediction distributions evolve throughout the network's processing hierarchy.

## Technical Details

The logit lens projects intermediate activations after layer ℓ through the final layer normalization and unembedding matrix to obtain layer-wise predictions, involving taking intermediate representations, applying the final layer normalization, and projecting through the unembedding matrix.

The logit lens has inspired follow-up work, including the Tuned Lens, which applies learned transformations to intermediate activations for clearer interpretation. This method has proven invaluable for analyzing reasoning pathways, multilingual representations, and safety-critical behaviors.

MultiChallenge is a pioneering benchmark evaluating large language models (LLMs) on conducting multi-turn conversations with human users, a crucial yet underexamined capability for their applications.

## Key Contributions
MultiChallenge identifies four categories of challenges in multi-turn conversations that are not only common and realistic among current human-LLM interactions, but are also challenging to all current frontier LLMs. All 4 challenges require accurate instruction-following, context allocation, and in-context reasoning at the same time.

Despite achieving near-perfect scores on existing multi-turn evaluation benchmarks, all frontier models have less than 50% accuracy on MultiChallenge, with the top-performing Claude 3.5 Sonnet (June 2024) achieving just a 41.4% average accuracy.

      - title: "Eliciting Latent Predictions from Transformers with the Tuned Lens"
        authors: "Belrose et al."

        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "通过逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向的渐进精化过程，支撑 ThreadGate 中不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机"
        abstract: "Trains per-layer affine probes on frozen pretrained LLMs to decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions, extending the logit lens. Shows how predictions are iteratively refined across transformer depth up to 20B-parameter models."

categories:
  layer_importance:
    description: "Layer-wise importance analysis, redundancy, and pruning in transformers"
    papers:
      - title: "The Unreasonable Ineffectiveness of the Deeper Layers"
        authors: "Gromov et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17887"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "发现 LLM 深层高度冗余，可删除近半层而性能不降；浅层对知识存储至关重要。直接支撑 ThreadGate 对 early layer 重要性的假设"
        abstract: "Studies knowledge storage via layer pruning. Finds minimal performance degradation until up to half of layers are removed. Implies shallow layers play a critical role in storing knowledge, while deeper layers are underutilized by current pretraining."

      - title: "ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect"
        authors: "Men et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03853"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "提出 Block Influence (BI) 度量各层重要性，发现许多层高度相似且功能冗余。BI 方法可对比 ThreadGate 中 gate 值分布"
        abstract: "Defines Block Influence (BI) metric to gauge layer significance. Proposes direct layer removal based on BI scores. Discovers many LLM layers exhibit high similarity and play negligible roles in network functionality."

      - title: "The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models"
        authors: "Sun et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05795"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "揭示 Pre-LN 导致深层输出方差指数增长，深层梯度趋近恒等映射。解释了为什么 ThreadGate 中 late layers gate 接近 1.0（深层本身贡献小）"
        abstract: "Explains why deeper layers in LLMs contribute less: Pre-Layer Normalization causes output variance to grow exponentially with depth, making deep layer derivatives approach identity. Proposes LayerNorm Scaling (LNS). Confirmed across Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen."

      - title: "Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15558"
        role: context
        relevance: "大规模 benchmark 发现简单删除最后 25% 层 + 微调即可获得强性能，进一步证实深层冗余"
        abstract: "Conducts thousands of GPU hours benchmarking layer pruning. Finds that simply pruning the final 25% of layers followed by fine-tuning the lm_head and remaining last three layers yields remarkably strong performance."

      - title: "Reducing Transformer Depth on Demand with Structured Dropout (LayerDrop)"
        authors: "Fan et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2020"
        year: 2020
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.11556"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "提出 LayerDrop：训练时对整层做 structured dropout，推理时可按需提取任意深度子网络。ThreadGate 的 gating 机制可视为 LayerDrop 的 soft 版本"
        abstract: "Applies structured dropout to entire transformer layers during training. Enables extracting sub-networks of any depth at test time from a single large pre-trained model without finetuning. Simple to implement and regularizes very deep transformers."

  multi_turn_attention:
    description: "Attention degradation and instruction following failure in multi-turn or long-context scenarios"
    papers:
      - title: "When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction"
        authors: "Dongre et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12922"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "提出 Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR) 度量 attention 对 goal tokens 的可达性，发现多轮交互中 GAR 衰减。与 ThreadGate 研究的 GAR 衰减问题直接对应，是最相关的论文"
        abstract: "Proposes Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR) measuring attention from generated tokens to task-defining goal tokens. Shows goal-defining tokens become less accessible through attention across turns while goal information may persist in residual representations. Layer encoding depth varies from layer 2 to 27 across architectures."

      - title: "LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Levy et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%。提供了 ThreadGate 要解决的问题的定量基准"
        abstract: "All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop across six generation tasks. Decomposes degradation into minor aptitude loss and significant unreliability increase (+112%). Models prematurely propose answers and overly rely on previous incorrect attempts."

      - title: "Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338"
        role: context
        relevance: "认为多轮失败的根因是 intent alignment gap 而非模型能力不足，且 scaling 无法解决。为 ThreadGate 的架构级方案提供动机"
        abstract: "Argues that Lost in Conversation stems from an intent alignment gap rather than intrinsic capability deficits. Theoretically shows that scaling model size or improving training alone cannot resolve this gap, as it arises from structural ambiguity in conversational context."

      - title: "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "TACL 2024"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "发现 LLM 对长上下文呈 U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。ThreadGate 关注的多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展"
        abstract: "Finds performance is highest when relevant information occurs at beginning or end of input context, significantly degrading for middle positions. Demonstrates U-shaped attention pattern across multiple LLM architectures. Some attention heads only attend to beginning and end."

      - title: "Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578"
        role: context
        relevance: "报告多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循的衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重。体现多轮退化的另一个维度"
        abstract: "Investigates speaking style degradation in multi-turn spoken language models. Finds style instruction placed in system messages degrades more than in user messages, despite system messages being designed for persistent conversation-level instructions."

    description: "Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth"
    papers:
      - title: "Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models"
        authors: "Raposo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "用 top-k routing 决定每层处理哪些 token，允许非单调 layer skipping。ThreadGate 的 turn-conditioned gating 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化"
        abstract: "Transformers learn to dynamically allocate FLOPs to specific sequence positions per layer via top-k routing. Tokens can skip middle layers then be updated via self-attention with tokens that went through all layers. Achieves 1.5% improvement in training loss or 50% FLOP reduction at parity."

      - title: "Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)"
        authors: "Schuster et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "基于置信度的 early exit 框架，每 token 动态分配计算深度。ThreadGate 的 gating 机制与 CALM 的 early exit 互补：CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating"
        abstract: "Framework for dynamically allocating different amounts of compute per input and generation timestep based on confidence. Achieves up to 3x speedup while provably maintaining high performance. Addresses challenges of confidence measures, sequence-level constraints, and attending to missing representations."

        authors: "Qiu et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "在 SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 可消除 attention sink、提升稳定性。ThreadGate 的 gating 设计可参考其 head-specific sigmoid gate 机制"
        abstract: "Applies head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA output. Comprehensive comparison over 30 variants of 15B MoE and 1.7B dense models. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4% on first token), improves training stability, and enhances scaling properties."

        authors: "Wang et al."
        venue: "ECCV 2018"
        year: 2018
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "残差网络中用 gating network 逐层决定是否 skip，用 RL+SL 混合训练解决不可微问题。ThreadGate 的 per-layer gating 设计的先驱工作"
        abstract: "Uses gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks based on previous layer activations. Frames dynamic skipping as sequential decision problem. Hybrid supervised+reinforcement learning for non-differentiable decisions. Reduces computation 30-90% while preserving accuracy."

        venue: "arXiv 2025"

        abstract: "FlexiDepth dynamically adjusts Transformer layers used during generation via plug-in router and adapter, without modifying original parameters. Applied to Llama-3-8B, skips 8/32 layers while maintaining full benchmark performance."

        authors: "Lawson et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103"
        role: context
        relevance: "尝试 symmetric middle-out layer skipping + gated attention，但在其实验规模下未优于 dense baseline。提供了负面结果参考"
        abstract: "Proposes gating mechanism that skips variable number of middle Transformer blocks based on input token. At investigated scales, does not improve validation cross-entropy vs FLOPs trade-off compared to dense baselines with fewer layers. Valuable negative result."

        authors: "Press et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "ALiBi 通过在注意力分数上施加距离线性惩罚实现长度外推，是无需修改残差连接即可操纵注意力分布的代表方法，与 ThreadGate 的残差门控路线形成设计空间对比"

        role: foundation
        relevance: "位置插值通过线性压缩 RoPE 位置索引扩展上下文至 32k，属于在注意力机制内部解决长序列问题的路线，与 ThreadGate 在残差层解决多轮衰减形成对比"

        abstract: "LM-Infinite applies a Λ-shaped attention mask attending to a local window plus initial tokens combined with a distance limit on position encodings, requiring no parameter updates. Generalizes LLMs to inputs of up to 200M tokens with 2.7x decoding speedup."

        authors: "Ko et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16008"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "直接通过校准注意力位置偏置修复中段信息丢失，是最接近 ThreadGate 问题定义的注意力操纵方案，审稿人会以此质疑为何不直接修正注意力而要引入残差门控"

        venue: "arXiv 2023"

        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "通过逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向的渐进精化过程，支撑 ThreadGate 中不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机"
        abstract: "Trains per-layer affine probes on frozen pretrained LLMs to decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions, extending the logit lens. Shows how predictions are iteratively refined across transformer depth up to 20B-parameter models."

      - title: "Exploring the Residual Stream of Transformers"
        authors: "Yu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.12141"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "分析残差连接对 logit 空间的直接加法效应，揭示知识参数跨层分布规律，为 ThreadGate 定位门控插入层提供实证参考"
        abstract: "Analyzes the residual stream from a mechanistic interpretability perspective, showing that residual connections act as direct additive operations on pre-softmax logits. Identifies which layers and modules store factual knowledge and how this storage is distributed across depth."

      - title: "Attention with Markov: A Framework for Principled Analysis of Transformers via Markov Chains"
        authors: "Makkuva et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04161"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "用 Markov 链理论刻画注意力机制的深度依赖性，解释为何浅层单层 transformer 无法形成归纳头，从理论角度支持 ThreadGate 在多层残差路径上施加门控的必要性"
        abstract: "Provides a theoretical framework analyzing transformer training and expressivity through Markov chain properties. Shows that two-layer transformers consistently learn induction heads on first-order Markov data while single-layer models get trapped in unigram local minima."

      - title: "From Self-Attention to Markov Models: Unveiling the Dynamics of Generative Transformers"
        authors: "Ildiz et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13512"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "建立自注意力与上下文条件 Markov 链之间的精确映射，为分析多轮对话中 token 分布随历史轮次漂移（GAR decay）提供随机过程理论基础"
        abstract: "Establishes a precise mathematical equivalence between self-attention and context-conditioned Markov chains, where the output token distribution is sampled from a transition matrix weighted by context. Provides theoretical tools to analyze generation dynamics and token distribution shifts."

        abstract: "Proposes a length-controlled variant of AlpacaEval that fits a generalized linear model to predict annotator preferences conditioned on output length, debiasing the original metric. Validated against 20K human annotations."

        authors: "Lin et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"

        abstract: "Selects 1,024 challenging tasks from over 1M human-chatbot conversation logs. Introduces WB-Reward and WB-Score metrics computed with GPT-4-turbo, achieving 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena ELO on hard tasks."

        authors: "Bai et al."
        venue: "ACL 2024"

        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14762"

        abstract: "Constructs a three-tier hierarchical ability taxonomy covering 4,208 turns across 1,388 multi-turn dialogues in 13 tasks. Evaluates 21 LLMs, finding that neither alignment techniques nor chat-specific designs consistently improve multi-turn abilities."

        venue: "ICLR 2025"

        role: foundation
        relevance: "发现 LLM 深层高度冗余，可删除近半层而性能不降；浅层对知识存储至关重要"
        abstract: "Studies knowledge storage via layer pruning. Finds minimal performance degradation until up to half of layers are removed."

      - title: "ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect"
        authors: "Men et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024

        role: foundation

      - title: "The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models"
        authors: "Sun et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05795"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "Pre-LN 导致深层梯度趋近恒等映射。解释 ThreadGate 中 late layers gate 接近 1.0"
        abstract: "Pre-Layer Normalization causes output variance to grow exponentially with depth."

      - title: "Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15558"
        role: context
        relevance: "删除最后 25% 层 + 微调即可获得强性能，证实深层冗余"
        abstract: "Simply pruning the final 25% of layers followed by fine-tuning yields strong performance."

      - title: "Reducing Transformer Depth on Demand with Structured Dropout (LayerDrop)"
        authors: "Fan et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2020"
        year: 2020
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.11556"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "ThreadGate 的 gating 可视为 LayerDrop 的 soft 版本"
        abstract: "Structured dropout on entire transformer layers during training."

  multi_turn_attention:
    description: "Attention degradation and instruction following failure in multi-turn or long-context scenarios"
    papers:
      - title: "When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction"
        authors: "Dongre, Hsieh, Lai, Yoon, Bui, Hakkani-Tur"
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12922"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "定义 GAR，诊断多轮 attention 通道关闭。纯诊断论文，未提出干预方案。ThreadGate 是首个基于其诊断的干预方法"
        abstract: "Channel-transition account: goal tokens become less accessible through attention while goal info persists in residual representations. Introduces GAR metric."
        notes:
          gar_definition: "GAR(τ) = (1/L·H·|ℛτ|) Σℓ Σh Σi∈ℛτ Σj∈𝒢 A_{i,j}. ALL layers, ALL heads averaged. Goal tokens = system prompt task-specifying tokens only"
          models_tested: "Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5 (3B/7B/14B/32B), Mixtral-8x7B + 6 additional"
          gar_decline: "27-48% over 50 turns, monotonic (Mann-Kendall p<1e-7)"
          residual_probes: "LDA on PCA-reduced residuals (50 PCs). Peak AUC: LLaMA L2=0.99, Qwen L11=0.98, Mixtral L21=0.99, Mistral L27=0.87"
          qwen_layer_profile: "Goal encoding rises steeply from L5. Our v3b L4 outlier may be the layer just before goal encoding begins"
          intervention_tested: "Periodic goal re-injection FAILED (Appendix H)"
          no_solution: true
          sliding_window: "Attention mask W=4096, Qwen crossover at turn 20. Linear W-vs-crossover (R2~1)"
          framing_impact: "GAR not our original metric. No intervention proposed -> ThreadGate is first solution. Residual persistence directly supports our theory"

      - title: "LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Levy et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%"
        abstract: "All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop."

      - title: "Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮失败根因是 intent alignment gap，scaling 无法解决。支撑 ThreadGate 架构级方案动机"
        abstract: "Lost in Conversation stems from intent alignment gap, not capability deficits. Scaling cannot resolve."

      - title: "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "TACL 2024"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展"
        abstract: "Performance highest at beginning/end of context, degrading for middle positions."

      - title: "Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重"
        abstract: "Style instruction in system messages degrades more than in user messages across turns."

  residual_gating:
    description: "Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth"
    papers:
      - title: "Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models"
        authors: "Raposo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "top-k routing 动态分配计算。ThreadGate 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocate FLOPs per layer via top-k routing. 1.5% loss improvement or 50% FLOP reduction."

      - title: "Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)"
        authors: "Schuster et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "置信度 early exit。CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocating compute per input based on confidence. Up to 3x speedup."

      - title: "Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free"
        authors: "Qiu et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 消除 attention sink。可参考 head-specific sigmoid gate 设计"
        abstract: "Head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4%)."

      - title: "SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks"
        authors: "Wang et al."
        venue: "ECCV 2018"
        year: 2018
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "残差网络逐层 gating 先驱。ThreadGate per-layer gating 的前身"
        abstract: "Gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks. RL+SL hybrid training."

      - title: "Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs (FlexiDepth)"
        authors: "Luo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23798"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "plug-in router+adapter on frozen LLM 自适应 layer skipping。与 ThreadGate 高度类似，直接竞品"
        abstract: "Dynamically adjusts layers via plug-in router and adapter. Llama-3-8B skips 8/32 layers maintaining performance."

      - title: "Learning to Skip the Middle Layers of Transformers"
        authors: "Lawson et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103"
        role: context
        relevance: "middle-out layer skipping 负面结果参考"
        abstract: "Gating to skip middle blocks. Does not improve vs dense baselines at investigated scales."

  attention_manipulation:
    description: "Methods that modify attention weights, positional encoding, or attention distributions to handle long-range dependencies"
    papers:
      - title: "Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases Enables Input Length Extrapolation"
        authors: "Press et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "ALiBi 在注意力分数上施加距离线性惩罚实现长度外推，是注意力操纵路线的代表方法，与 ThreadGate 残差门控路线形成设计空间对比"
        abstract: "Replaces positional embeddings with linear bias on attention logits penalizing distance. 1.3B model trained on 1024 generalizes to 2048 without fine-tuning."

      - title: "Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation"
        authors: "Chen et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15595"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "位置插值通过压缩 RoPE 索引扩展上下文至 32k，属于注意力机制内部解决长序列的路线，与 ThreadGate 在残差层解决多轮衰减形成对比"
        abstract: "Linearly down-scales RoPE position indices to extend context to 32768 tokens in 1000 fine-tuning steps."

      - title: "YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models"
        authors: "Peng et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "YaRN 综合 NTK-aware 和分段插值改进 RoPE 外推，代表注意力位置编码修改应对长程衰减的成熟路线，与 ThreadGate 机制不同"
        abstract: "Combines NTK-aware interpolation with ramp function for different RoPE frequency components. Extends LLaMA-2 to 128k context with 10x fewer tokens."

      - title: "Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks"
        authors: "Xiao et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.17453"
        role: context
        relevance: "发现 attention sink 现象（初始 token 聚集高权重），说明多轮对话中早期轮次 token 天然受偏置，ThreadGate 从残差路径角度控制历史轮信息保留"
        abstract: "LLMs assign disproportionate attention to first few tokens regardless of semantics. Retaining sink tokens enables stable streaming inference over 4M tokens."

      - title: "LM-Infinite: Zero-Shot Extreme Length Generalization for Large Language Models"
        authors: "Han et al."
        venue: "ACL 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.16137"
        role: context
        relevance: "用 Λ 形注意力掩码加距离截断实现超长上下文推理，揭示调整注意力掩码和调整残差门控是两条平行路线"
        abstract: "Applies Λ-shaped attention mask plus distance limit on position encodings. Generalizes to 200M tokens with 2.7x speedup, no parameter updates."

      - title: "Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization"
        authors: "Ko et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16008"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "直接校准注意力位置偏置修复中段信息丢失，最接近 ThreadGate 问题定义的注意力方案，审稿人会以此质疑为何不直接修正注意力"
        abstract: "Identifies U-shaped positional attention bias causing lost-in-the-middle. Training-free calibration redistributes attention to middle positions, improving QA by 6-15pp."

  theoretical_foundations:
    description: "Theoretical analysis of transformer residual streams, information flow, and attention dynamics"
    papers:
      - title: "A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits"
        authors: "Elhage et al."
        venue: "Transformer Circuits Thread 2021"
        year: 2021
        url: "https://transformer-circuits.pub/2021/framework/index.html"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "提出残差流作为 transformer 各组件通信核心通道，直接为 ThreadGate 在残差连接处插入门控提供机制解释框架"
        abstract: "Linear algebraic decomposition of transformer computations. Attention heads and MLPs as read/write operations on shared residual stream. Formalizes induction heads and QK/OV circuits."

      - title: "Toy Models of Superposition"
        authors: "Elhage et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.10652"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "揭示残差流子空间叠加存储稀疏特征的机制，为 ThreadGate 按轮次条件化选择性激活残差通道提供理论依据"
        abstract: "Neural networks store more features than dimensions via superposition when features are sparse. Links polysemanticity to geometry of uniform polytopes."

      - title: "Eliciting Latent Predictions from Transformers with the Tuned Lens"
        authors: "Belrose et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向渐进精化，支撑 ThreadGate 不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机"
        abstract: "Per-layer affine probes decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions. Shows predictions iteratively refined across depth up to 20B parameters."

      - title: "Exploring the Residual Stream of Transformers"
        authors: "Yu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.12141"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "分析残差连接对 logit 空间的加法效应，揭示知识参数跨层分布规律，为 ThreadGate 定位门控插入层提供实证参考"
        abstract: "Residual connections act as direct additive operations on pre-softmax logits. Identifies factual knowledge storage distribution across layers and modules."

      - title: "Attention with Markov: A Framework for Principled Analysis of Transformers via Markov Chains"
        authors: "Makkuva et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04161"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "用 Markov 链理论刻画注意力深度依赖性，解释为何单层 transformer 无法形成归纳头，支持 ThreadGate 在多层残差路径施加门控的必要性"
        abstract: "Theoretical framework via Markov chain properties. Two-layer transformers learn induction heads on first-order Markov data; single-layer models get trapped in unigram minima."

      - title: "From Self-Attention to Markov Models: Unveiling the Dynamics of Generative Transformers"
        authors: "Ildiz et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13512"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "建立自注意力与上下文条件 Markov 链的精确映射，为分析多轮对话 token 分布随轮次漂移（GAR decay）提供随机过程理论基础"
        abstract: "Mathematical equivalence between self-attention and context-conditioned Markov chains. Output distribution sampled from context-weighted transition matrix."

  evaluation_benchmarks:
    description: "Multi-turn dialogue and instruction-following evaluation benchmarks for LLMs"
    papers:
      - title: "Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena"
        authors: "Zheng et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "MT-Bench 多轮对话评测框架，是 ThreadGate 验证多轮 GAR 衰减修复效果的核心 benchmark"
        abstract: "Introduces MT-Bench (80 multi-turn questions) and Chatbot Arena. GPT-4 achieves >80% agreement with human preferences as judge."

      - title: "Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference"
        authors: "Chiang et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04132"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "基于 ELO 排名的人类偏好评估体系，衡量多轮对话模型综合能力的权威 leaderboard"
        abstract: "Chatbot Arena with 240K+ votes from 90K+ users across 50+ models. Bradley-Terry and ELO ranking validated against expert raters."

      - title: "Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators"
        authors: "Dubois et al."
        venue: "COLM 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04475"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "指令遵循自动评测标准，Length-Controlled 版本修正长度偏差，为 ThreadGate 单轮指令评测提供对比基线"
        abstract: "GLM-based length debiasing for AlpacaEval. Validated against 20K human annotations."

      - title: "WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild"
        authors: "Lin et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04770"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "真实用户多样化指令集，评估 wild 场景指令遵循能力，与 ThreadGate 关注的真实多轮对话性能高度相关"
        abstract: "1,024 challenging tasks from 1M+ conversation logs. WB-Reward/WB-Score achieve 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena ELO on hard tasks."

      - title: "MT-Bench-101: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues"
        authors: "Bai et al."
        venue: "ACL 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14762"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "多轮对话细粒度评测体系，直接测量跨轮次能力退化，与 ThreadGate 研究的 GAR 衰减高度吻合"
        abstract: "Three-tier ability taxonomy, 4,208 turns across 1,388 dialogues in 13 tasks. Neither alignment nor chat-specific designs consistently improve multi-turn abilities."

      - title: "MultiChallenge: A Realistic Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark Challenging to Frontier LLMs"
        authors: "Sirdeshmukh et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.17399"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "前沿 LLM 多轮对话准确率不足 50%，直接测量 ThreadGate 旨在修复的跨轮指令保留和上下文一致性失败"
        abstract: "Four challenge categories: instruction retention, user inference memory, versioned editing, self-coherence. All frontier LLMs below 50%; Claude 3.5 Sonnet tops at 41.4%."

        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%"
        abstract: "All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop."

      - title: "Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮失败根因是 intent alignment gap，scaling 无法解决。支撑 ThreadGate 架构级方案动机"
        abstract: "Lost in Conversation stems from intent alignment gap, not capability deficits. Scaling cannot resolve."

      - title: "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "TACL 2024"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展"
        abstract: "Performance highest at beginning/end of context, degrading for middle positions."

      - title: "Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重"
        abstract: "Style instruction in system messages degrades more than in user messages across turns."

  residual_gating:
    description: "Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth"
    papers:
      - title: "Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models"
        authors: "Raposo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "top-k routing 动态分配计算。ThreadGate 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocate FLOPs per layer via top-k routing. 1.5% loss improvement or 50% FLOP reduction."

      - title: "Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)"
        authors: "Schuster et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "置信度 early exit。CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocating compute per input based on confidence. Up to 3x speedup."

      - title: "Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free"
        authors: "Qiu et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 消除 attention sink。可参考 head-specific sigmoid gate 设计"
        abstract: "Head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4%)."

      - title: "SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks"
        authors: "Wang et al."
        venue: "ECCV 2018"
        year: 2018
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "残差网络逐层 gating 先驱。ThreadGate per-layer gating 的前身"
        abstract: "Gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks. RL+SL hybrid training."

      - title: "Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs (FlexiDepth)"
        authors: "Luo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23798"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "plug-in router+adapter on frozen LLM 自适应 layer skipping。与 ThreadGate 高度类似，直接竞品"
        abstract: "Dynamically adjusts layers via plug-in router and adapter. Llama-3-8B skips 8/32 layers maintaining performance."

      - title: "Learning to Skip the Middle Layers of Transformers"
        authors: "Lawson et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103"
        role: context
        relevance: "middle-out layer skipping 负面结果参考"
        abstract: "Gating to skip middle blocks. Does not improve vs dense baselines at investigated scales."

  attention_manipulation:
    description: "Methods that modify attention weights, positional encoding, or attention distributions to handle long-range dependencies"
    papers:
      - title: "Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases Enables Input Length Extrapolation"
        authors: "Press et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "ALiBi 在注意力分数上施加距离线性惩罚实现长度外推，是注意力操纵路线的代表方法，与 ThreadGate 残差门控路线形成设计空间对比"
        abstract: "Replaces positional embeddings with linear bias on attention logits penalizing distance. 1.3B model trained on 1024 generalizes to 2048 without fine-tuning."

      - title: "Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation"
        authors: "Chen et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15595"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "位置插值通过压缩 RoPE 索引扩展上下文至 32k，属于注意力机制内部解决长序列的路线，与 ThreadGate 在残差层解决多轮衰减形成对比"
        abstract: "Linearly down-scales RoPE position indices to extend context to 32768 tokens in 1000 fine-tuning steps."

      - title: "YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models"
        authors: "Peng et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "YaRN 综合 NTK-aware 和分段插值改进 RoPE 外推，代表注意力位置编码修改应对长程衰减的成熟路线，与 ThreadGate 机制不同"
        abstract: "Combines NTK-aware interpolation with ramp function for different RoPE frequency components. Extends LLaMA-2 to 128k context with 10x fewer tokens."

      - title: "Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks"
        authors: "Xiao et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.17453"
        role: context
        relevance: "发现 attention sink 现象（初始 token 聚集高权重），说明多轮对话中早期轮次 token 天然受偏置，ThreadGate 从残差路径角度控制历史轮信息保留"
        abstract: "LLMs assign disproportionate attention to first few tokens regardless of semantics. Retaining sink tokens enables stable streaming inference over 4M tokens."

      - title: "LM-Infinite: Zero-Shot Extreme Length Generalization for Large Language Models"
        authors: "Han et al."
        venue: "ACL 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.16137"
        role: context
        relevance: "用 Λ 形注意力掩码加距离截断实现超长上下文推理，揭示调整注意力掩码和调整残差门控是两条平行路线"
        abstract: "Applies Λ-shaped attention mask plus distance limit on position encodings. Generalizes to 200M tokens with 2.7x speedup, no parameter updates."

      - title: "Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization"
        authors: "Ko et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16008"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "直接校准注意力位置偏置修复中段信息丢失，最接近 ThreadGate 问题定义的注意力方案，审稿人会以此质疑为何不直接修正注意力"
        abstract: "Identifies U-shaped positional attention bias causing lost-in-the-middle. Training-free calibration redistributes attention to middle positions, improving QA by 6-15pp."

  theoretical_foundations:
    description: "Theoretical analysis of transformer residual streams, information flow, and attention dynamics"
    papers:
      - title: "A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits"
        authors: "Elhage et al."
        venue: "Transformer Circuits Thread 2021"
        year: 2021
        url: "https://transformer-circuits.pub/2021/framework/index.html"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "提出残差流作为 transformer 各组件通信核心通道，直接为 ThreadGate 在残差连接处插入门控提供机制解释框架"
        abstract: "Linear algebraic decomposition of transformer computations. Attention heads and MLPs as read/write operations on shared residual stream. Formalizes induction heads and QK/OV circuits."

      - title: "Toy Models of Superposition"
        authors: "Elhage et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.10652"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "揭示残差流子空间叠加存储稀疏特征的机制，为 ThreadGate 按轮次条件化选择性激活残差通道提供理论依据"
        abstract: "Neural networks store more features than dimensions via superposition when features are sparse. Links polysemanticity to geometry of uniform polytopes."

      - title: "Eliciting Latent Predictions from Transformers with the Tuned Lens"
        authors: "Belrose et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向渐进精化，支撑 ThreadGate 不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机"
        abstract: "Per-layer affine probes decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions. Shows predictions iteratively refined across depth up to 20B parameters."

      - title: "Exploring the Residual Stream of Transformers"
        authors: "Yu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.12141"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "分析残差连接对 logit 空间的加法效应，揭示知识参数跨层分布规律，为 ThreadGate 定位门控插入层提供实证参考"
        abstract: "Residual connections act as direct additive operations on pre-softmax logits. Identifies factual knowledge storage distribution across layers and modules."

      - title: "Attention with Markov: A Framework for Principled Analysis of Transformers via Markov Chains"
        authors: "Makkuva et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04161"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "用 Markov 链理论刻画注意力深度依赖性，解释为何单层 transformer 无法形成归纳头，支持 ThreadGate 在多层残差路径施加门控的必要性"
        abstract: "Theoretical framework via Markov chain properties. Two-layer transformers learn induction heads on first-order Markov data; single-layer models get trapped in unigram minima."

      - title: "From Self-Attention to Markov Models: Unveiling the Dynamics of Generative Transformers"
        authors: "Ildiz et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13512"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "建立自注意力与上下文条件 Markov 链的精确映射，为分析多轮对话 token 分布随轮次漂移（GAR decay）提供随机过程理论基础"
        abstract: "Mathematical equivalence between self-attention and context-conditioned Markov chains. Output distribution sampled from context-weighted transition matrix."

  evaluation_benchmarks:
    description: "Multi-turn dialogue and instruction-following evaluation benchmarks for LLMs"
    papers:
      - title: "Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena"
        authors: "Zheng et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2023"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "MT-Bench 多轮对话评测框架，是 ThreadGate 验证多轮 GAR 衰减修复效果的核心 benchmark"
        abstract: "Introduces MT-Bench (80 multi-turn questions) and Chatbot Arena. GPT-4 achieves >80% agreement with human preferences as judge."

      - title: "Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference"
        authors: "Chiang et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04132"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "基于 ELO 排名的人类偏好评估体系，衡量多轮对话模型综合能力的权威 leaderboard"
        abstract: "Chatbot Arena with 240K+ votes from 90K+ users across 50+ models. Bradley-Terry and ELO ranking validated against expert raters."

      - title: "Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators"
        authors: "Dubois et al."
        venue: "COLM 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04475"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "指令遵循自动评测标准，Length-Controlled 版本修正长度偏差，为 ThreadGate 单轮指令评测提供对比基线"
        abstract: "GLM-based length debiasing for AlpacaEval. Validated against 20K human annotations."

      - title: "WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild"
        authors: "Lin et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04770"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "真实用户多样化指令集，评估 wild 场景指令遵循能力，与 ThreadGate 关注的真实多轮对话性能高度相关"
        abstract: "1,024 challenging tasks from 1M+ conversation logs. WB-Reward/WB-Score achieve 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena ELO on hard tasks."

      - title: "MT-Bench-101: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues"
        authors: "Bai et al."
        venue: "ACL 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14762"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "多轮对话细粒度评测体系，直接测量跨轮次能力退化，与 ThreadGate 研究的 GAR 衰减高度吻合"
        abstract: "Three-tier ability taxonomy, 4,208 turns across 1,388 dialogues in 13 tasks. Neither alignment nor chat-specific designs consistently improve multi-turn abilities."

      - title: "MultiChallenge: A Realistic Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark Challenging to Frontier LLMs"
        authors: "Sirdeshmukh et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.17399"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "前沿 LLM 多轮对话准确率不足 50%，直接测量 ThreadGate 旨在修复的跨轮指令保留和上下文一致性失败"
        abstract: "Four challenge categories: instruction retention, user inference memory, versioned editing, self-coherence. All frontier LLMs below 50%; Claude 3.5 Sonnet tops at 41.4%."

categories:
  layer_importance:
    description: "Layer-wise importance analysis, redundancy, and pruning in transformers"
    papers:
      - title: "The Unreasonable Ineffectiveness of the Deeper Layers"
        authors: "Gromov et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17887"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "发现 LLM 深层高度冗余，可删除近半层而性能不降；浅层对知识存储至关重要"
        abstract: "Studies knowledge storage via layer pruning. Finds minimal performance degradation until up to half of layers are removed."

      - title: "ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect"
        authors: "Men et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03853"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "提出 Block Influence (BI) 度量各层重要性，发现许多层高度相似且功能冗余"
        abstract: "Defines Block Influence (BI) metric to gauge layer significance. Discovers many LLM layers exhibit high similarity."

      - title: "The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models"
        authors: "Sun et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05795"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "Pre-LN 导致深层梯度趋近恒等映射。解释 ThreadGate 中 late layers gate 接近 1.0"
        abstract: "Pre-Layer Normalization causes output variance to grow exponentially with depth."

      - title: "Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2024"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15558"
        role: context
        relevance: "删除最后 25% 层 + 微调即可获得强性能，证实深层冗余"
        abstract: "Simply pruning the final 25% of layers followed by fine-tuning yields strong performance."

      - title: "Reducing Transformer Depth on Demand with Structured Dropout (LayerDrop)"
        authors: "Fan et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2020"
        year: 2020
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.11556"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "ThreadGate 的 gating 可视为 LayerDrop 的 soft 版本"
        abstract: "Structured dropout on entire transformer layers during training."

  multi_turn_attention:
    description: "Attention degradation and instruction following failure in multi-turn or long-context scenarios"
    papers:
      - title: "When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction"
        authors: "Dongre, Hsieh, Lai, Yoon, Bui, Hakkani-Tur"
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12922"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "定义 GAR，诊断多轮 attention 通道关闭。纯诊断论文，未提出干预方案。ThreadGate 是首个基于其诊断的干预方法"
        abstract: "Channel-transition account: goal tokens become less accessible through attention while goal info persists in residual representations. Introduces GAR metric."
        notes:
          gar_definition: "GAR(τ) = (1/L·H·|ℛτ|) Σℓ Σh Σi∈ℛτ Σj∈𝒢 A_{i,j}. ALL layers, ALL heads averaged. Goal tokens = system prompt task-specifying tokens only"
          models_tested: "Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5 (3B/7B/14B/32B), Mixtral-8x7B + 6 additional"
          gar_decline: "27-48% over 50 turns, monotonic (Mann-Kendall p<1e-7)"
          residual_probes: "LDA on PCA-reduced residuals (50 PCs). Peak AUC: LLaMA L2=0.99, Qwen L11=0.98, Mixtral L21=0.99, Mistral L27=0.87"
          qwen_layer_profile: "Goal encoding rises steeply from L5. Our v3b L4 outlier may be the layer just before goal encoding begins"
          intervention_tested: "Periodic goal re-injection FAILED (Appendix H)"
          no_solution: true
          sliding_window: "Attention mask W=4096, Qwen crossover at turn 20. Linear W-vs-crossover (R2~1)"
          framing_impact: "GAR not our original metric. No intervention proposed -> ThreadGate is first solution. Residual persistence directly supports our theory"

      - title: "LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Levy et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%"
        abstract: "All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop."

      - title: "Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2026"
        year: 2026
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮失败根因是 intent alignment gap，scaling 无法解决。支撑 ThreadGate 架构级方案动机"
        abstract: "Lost in Conversation stems from intent alignment gap, not capability deficits. Scaling cannot resolve."

      - title: "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts"
        authors: "Liu et al."
        venue: "TACL 2024"
        year: 2023
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172"
        role: foundation
        relevance: "U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展"
        abstract: "Performance highest at beginning/end of context, degrading for middle positions."

      - title: "Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models"
        authors: "Anonymous"
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578"
        role: context
        relevance: "多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重"
        abstract: "Style instruction in system messages degrades more than in user messages across turns."

  residual_gating:
    description: "Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth"
    papers:
      - title: "Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models"
        authors: "Raposo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)"
        year: 2024
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "top-k routing 动态分配计算。ThreadGate 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocate FLOPs per layer via top-k routing. 1.5% loss improvement or 50% FLOP reduction."

      - title: "Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)"
        authors: "Schuster et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2022"
        year: 2022
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "置信度 early exit。CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating"
        abstract: "Dynamically allocating compute per input based on confidence. Up to 3x speedup."

      - title: "Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free"
        authors: "Qiu et al."
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 消除 attention sink。可参考 head-specific sigmoid gate 设计"
        abstract: "Head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4%)."

      - title: "SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks"
        authors: "Wang et al."
        venue: "ECCV 2018"
        year: 2018
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485"
        role: method-component
        relevance: "残差网络逐层 gating 先驱。ThreadGate per-layer gating 的前身"
        abstract: "Gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks. RL+SL hybrid training."

      - title: "Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs (FlexiDepth)"
        authors: "Luo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23798"
        role: direct-competitor
        relevance: "plug-in router+adapter on frozen LLM 自适应 layer skipping。与 ThreadGate 高度类似，直接竞品"
        abstract: "Dynamically adjusts layers via plug-in router and adapter. Llama-3-8B skips 8/32 layers maintaining performance."

      - title: "Learning to Skip the Middle Layers of Transformers"
        authors: "Lawson et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        year: 2025
        url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103"
        role: context
        relevance: "middle-out layer skipping 负面结果参考"
        abstract: "Gating to skip middle blocks. Does not improve vs dense baselines at investigated scales."
